channel.description: Latest articles from EVENTFAQS Media Pvt (eventfaqs.com)

item.title: Britannia Industries Ltd. Appoints Puneet Das as CMO; Elevates Siddharth Gupta to VP – Marketing
item.description: Britannia Industries has appointed Puneet Das as Chief Marketing Officer and elevated Siddharth Gupta to VP – Marketing, while reporting a 17.1% rise in quarterly net profit.

item.title: Marriott Bonvoy Expands ‘Good Travel’ Program Across APEC
item.description: Marriott International has expanded its Good Travel with Marriott Bonvoy™ program across Asia Pacific excluding China, offering nearly 100 community- and environment-focused experiences.

item.title: Gurdas Maan to Return to Mumbai With Exclusive ‘Live Like Never Before’ Concert on March 21
item.description: Gurdas Maan will perform a one-night-only concert at Mumbai’s NESCO Center on March 21, marking his sole India appearance during his current global tour.

item.title: The Diplomatist Magazine Announces 7th Agri Business Conclave & Awards 2026 Under Diplomatist@30 Initiative
item.description: The Diplomatist Magazine will host the 7th Agri Business Conclave & Awards on March 24, 2026, focusing on global partnerships, sustainable agriculture, and the International Year of the Woman Farmer.

item.title: Anyma Announces India Debut with ÆDEN Show in Mumbai
item.description: Global techno artist Anyma will perform in India for the first time on November 21, 2026, at Mumbai’s Mahalaxmi Racecourse, with tickets going on sale via BookMyShow.

item.title: Deepali Designs & Exhibits Announces Opening of IHGF Delhi Fair – Spring 2026 Tomorrow
item.description: The 61st edition of the global sourcing show begins on 14 February at the India Expo Centre & Mart, as Deepali Designs & Exhibits Pvt. Ltd. spotlights Indian craftsmanship and design innovation for international buyers.

item.title: Esports World Cup Foundation Reveals First Eight Titles for Esports Nations Cup 2026
item.description: The Esports World Cup Foundation has unveiled the first eight game titles for the Esports Nations Cup 2026, with national teams set to compete in Riyadh this November.

item.title: PUMA India, Bumble & HYROX Launch Fitness-first Dating Format for India’s Singles
item.description: PUMA India, Bumble and HYROX introduce a fitness-first dating experience in Bengaluru, bringing singles together through movement, competition and real-world connection this Valentine’s Day.

item.title: Anandana – The Coca-Cola India Foundation Leads Responsible Waste and Public Convenience Initiatives at Magh Mela 2026
item.description: Anandana – The Coca-Cola India Foundation is supporting responsible waste management and public facilities at Magh Mela 2026.

item.title: Bengaluru to Host UN40 Music & Beyond Festival on March 14–15
item.description: UN40 Music & Beyond arrives at NICE Grounds on March 14–15, bringing a multi-genre lineup including Himesh Reshammiya and more for a two-day music and entertainment experience in Bengaluru.
